newsitem.title: USA: Schawk installs $1 million of imaging units.
newsitem.headline: Schawk installs $1 million of imaging units.

text.p: Schwak Inc said Tuesday it has installed about $1 million worth of digital imaging equipment that it expects to upgrade its remote on-site facility management locations to the same speed as its core production facilities.
"Industry demand remains exceptionally strong, and we expect this trend to continue for the foreseeable future," said Schawk chief executive officer David Schawk in a news release.
Schwak supplies electronic digitized high-resolution color imaging, data-base and on-site facility management.
Its shares traded up 1/4 at $10 in late trading Tuesday.
